senses.gloss: (= רְּהוּ, cmp. דִּי) who, which is, since he, it, &c.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 19:1:3">Y. Sabb. XIX, beg. 16ᵈ</cite> <he>דו אמר … הוא דאמר</he> the same that says …, says also &c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 1:1:21">Y. Peah I, 15ᶜ</cite> top <he>בגין דו בעי וכ׳</he> because he wants to teach &c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 1:4:5">Y. Maasr. I, 49ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>מן דו</he> from the time that.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 9:6:2">Y. Gitt. IX, 50ᶜ</cite> top nobody says ‘even’ <he>אלא דו מודה וכ׳</he> except he admits the preceding; a. fr.
